qa_summary: The candidate ontology provides a structured representation of aviation emergency landing procedures and related concepts. It covers most competency questions but lacks explicit definitions for some properties and does not fully separate immediate actions from background information. Additionally, some classes and properties do not align with the manager's plan regarding definitions and responsibilities.

metadata.name: AviationEmergencyLandingOntology
metadata.description: A structured representation of aviation emergency landing procedures, conditions, and pilot actions to assist in decision-making during emergencies.

classes.name: EmergencyLanding
classes.definition: A landing performed under emergency conditions, often involving risks to the aircraft and occupants.

object_properties.name: governed_by
object_properties.definition: Indicates that the selection of an emergency landing site is influenced by terrain characteristics.

validation_rules.rule: An emergency landing must have a description and associated procedures.
Pilot actions must be linked to specific emergency scenarios.
Hazards must have a defined risk level.
